decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends Söbbeke's established, popular Demeter range and fits the core organic dairy brand, so it is very likely to remain.
The mild sliced organic cheese was launched recently, has its own product page, and serves a staple retail category, so the firm will likely give it more time on the market.
Sliced butter cheese is a standard, high-demand format in German supermarkets that complements the cheese line, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
